verification.method: Exact source and fixture comparison against HEAD; all changed snapshots confined to the extracted planner and added regression; 130 affected support/extrusion cases plus focused belt Print regressions; historical benchmark document hash verification.
verification.summary: Current geometric invariants are revalidated. No historical timing or full-project command-equality result is relabeled as a new benchmark. See the endpoint compatibility evidence for the retained source boundaries and individual belt cases.

conclusion: A locally collision-safe CONTACT_TO_MODEL candidate does not establish a flat model landing. Only avoidance-classified gracious candidates and build-plate candidates set to_model_gracious during organic tip initialization. Otherwise ordinary collision-based model-resting propagation must remain available for inclined surfaces; forcing flat-landing avoidance can delete valid tips and emit failed influence-area expansion warnings. Preserve normal branch clearances and the separate local contact-footprint exception. Current endpoint fixes additionally lower the independent bed-support layer only when necessary to preserve a nearby exact contact within minimum thickness constraints. Historical Benchy timing and path-comparison observations are not current-build guarantees.
